unitTitle: Present Perfect - Past Simple - Ever/Never - Just - Yet/Already - For/Since
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 67-BET. Unit 15 — Present Perfect va 1-15-unitlar takrori.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  7-mashq (10-15-bandlar): since, for, how long, yet, for, ever.
  8-mashq (10 ta variant tanlash): C, A, B, B, A, C, A, C, A, B.
  9-mashq (14 ta fe'l shakli): comes, will take, didn't play, Do you want, is sleeping, will help, does, Has Jim paid, is washing, have just turned, have you worked, hasn't travelled, don't we go, did you hear.
  10-mashq (moslash): 1f, 2d, 3h, 4a, 5i, 6b, 7j, 8c, 9e, 10g.
  11-mashq (Dublindan xat, 16 ta fe'l): is, am having, am staying, have been, have already done, have seen, was, have also visited, visited, showed, haven't done, haven't done, haven't been, is, am coming, will call.

⚠ 10-MAShQ — JAVOB SHAKLI SAVOLNI OChIB BERADI. Bu mashqni yechishning eng oson yo'li:
  'Have you ever...?'  → 'No, I HAVEN'T'   (have bilan)
  'Will it...?'        → 'Yes, it WILL'    (will bilan)
  'Do you...?'         → 'No, I DON'T'     (do bilan)
  'Is she...?'         → 'Yes, she IS'     (be bilan)
  'Are you...?'        → 'No, I'M NOT'     (be bilan)
  ⚠ Qolgan to'rttasi savol so'ziga qarab topiladi: 'What is she doing?' → ish; 'How often?' → chastota; 'How long?' → 'For four years'; 'When did?' → o'tgan vaqt; 'When are you leaving?' → kelasi vaqt.

⚠ 'HOW LONG' IKKI XIL JAVOB OLADI:
  'How LONG have you lived...?' → 'FOR four years' (davomiylik)
  'When DID you become...?'     → 'Seven years AGO' (o'tgan nuqta)
  ⚠ 'for' — hozirgacha davom etadi; 'ago' — tugagan.

⚠ 11-MAShQDA ENG QIYIN JOY — 6 va 9-band:
  6-band: 'I HAVE SEEN a play' — vaqt aytilmagan → Present Perfect.
  9-band: 'I VISITED it ON SATURDAY' — ANIQ vaqt bor → Past Simple.
  ⚠ Qoida: aniq o'tgan vaqt ko'rsatilsa — Past Simple; ko'rsatilmasa va natija hozirgacha muhim bo'lsa — Present Perfect.

⚠ 'The Guinness Brewery' va 'the Abbey Theatre' — Dublindagi haqiqiy joylar; 'Grafton Street' — Dublinning asosiy xarid ko'chasi. Imlosi to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in yet, how long, never, since, just, for or ever. (continued: 10-15)
exercises.instructionUz: yet, how long, never, since, just, for yoki ever ni qo'ying. (davomi: 10-15)
exercises.explanationUz:
7-MAShQNING OXIRGI OLTI BANDI
(66-betdan davom etadi)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  10  SINCE
  11  FOR
  12  HOW LONG
  13  YET
  14  FOR
  15  EVER


HAR BIRI NEGA:

10  'She has been on holiday ... LAST MONDAY.'
    'last Monday' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

11  'Jerry has been ill ... THREE DAYS.'
    'three days' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

12  '... have you been here?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.

13  'David HASN'T FOUND a job ...'
    INKOR gap → YET (gap oxirida).

14  'I have lived in this house ... EIGHT
     YEARS.'
    'eight years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

15  'This is the BEST hamburger I've ... had.'
    KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA → EVER.


DIQQAT — 15-BAND, USTUN DARAJA QURILMASI:
  'This is the BEST hamburger I've EVER had.'

  Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best
  place I've ever visited.'
  Grammar 66-bet, 3-mashq (10-band): 'Cairo is
  the best place I've ever visited.'

  Kitob bu qurilmani UCH marta takrorlagan.


DIQQAT — 11 va 14-BANDLAR:
  Ikkalasi ham 'ill' va 'lived' — ya'ni
  HOZIR HAM davom etayotgan holat
  (Grammar 64-betdagi IKKINCHI qo'llanish).

  'Jerry has been ill for three days.'
     = uch kundan beri kasal (HOZIR HAM)
  'I have lived in this house for eight
   years.'
     = sakkiz yildan beri shu uyda yashayman


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ill        = kasal
  to find a job = ish topmoq
  a hamburger = gamburger

items.sentence: 10  She has been on holiday .............................. last Monday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'last Monday' — 'LAST' bilan, ANIQ NUQTA
→ SINCE.

Solishtiring: 'FOR a week' (bir hafta
davomida).

items.sentence: 11  Jerry has been ill ......................... three days.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'three days' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI
→ DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

DIQQAT: hozir HAM kasal (Grammar 64-betdagi
IKKINCHI qo'llanish).

items.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri turibsiz?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.

Javobi: 'For three days.' yoki
'Since Monday.'

KALIT: 'HASN'T' — INKOR gap → YET.

'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA.
find → FOUND (V2 = V3).

items.sentence: 14  I have lived in this house ................ eight years.
items.uz: Sakkiz yildan beri shu uyda yashayman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'eight years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

DIQQAT: hozir HAM shu uyda yashayman —
IKKINCHI qo'llanish.
O'zbekchada HOZIRGI zamon bilan tarjima
qilinadi.

items.sentence: 15  This is the best hamburger I've .................. had.
items.uz: Bu men yegan eng yaxshi gamburger.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA → EVER.

'the best ... I've EVER had' — turg'un
qurilma.

Kitob buni UCH marta takrorlagan
(CB 106-bet, GB 66-bet, GB 67-bet).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C (work)
   2  A (visited)
   3  B (have tidied)
   4  B (is listening)
   5  A (went)
   6  C (has been)
   7  A (watch)
   8  C (is reading)
   9  A (bought)
  10  B (goes)


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1, 7, 10
     (doimiy, odat)
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 4, 8
     ('right now', 'at the moment')
  PAST SIMPLE — 2, 5, 9
     ('last weekend', 'last summer',
      'last month')
  PRESENT PERFECT — 3, 6
     (natija hozir ko'rinadi; 'for six years')


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'I'm a bellboy. I ... in a hotel.'
    DOIMIY ish (kasb) → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → C (work)
    ('am working' — vaqtinchalik degan ma'no
     berardi.)

 2  'He ... his sister LAST WEEKEND.'
    'last weekend' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (visited)

 3  'I ... my room. Can I watch TV, NOW?'
    Ish TUGAGAN va natijasi HOZIR muhim
    ('endi televizor ko'rsam bo'ladimi?')
    → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → B (have tidied)

 4  'She ... to music RIGHT NOW.'
    'right now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → B (is listening)

 5  'We ... to Canada LAST SUMMER.'
    'last summer' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (went)

 6  'Julie ... a chef FOR SIX YEARS.'
    'for six years' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → C (has been)
    ('be' va 'been' — yordamchi fe'lsiz
     ishlatilmaydi.)

 7  'I USUALLY ... TV EVERY AFTERNOON.'
    'usually', 'every afternoon' → odat
    → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → A (watch)

 8  'She ... a book AT THE MOMENT.'
    'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → C (is reading)

 9  'Joe ... some souvenirs LAST MONTH.'
    'last month' → PAST SIMPLE.
    → A (bought)

10  'My father ALWAYS ... to work by bus.'
    'always' → odat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK
    → fe'lga -S: GOES.
    → B (goes)


⚠ 10-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK,
  shuning uchun 'go' emas, 'GOES'.

  A (go) — grammatik jihatdan noto'g'ri.
  C (is going) — 'always' bilan mos kelmaydi.


VAQT IBORALARI — QISQA JADVAL:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     always, usually, often, sometimes,
     never, every day/afternoon

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     now, right now, at the moment,
     today, this week

  PAST SIMPLE:
     yesterday, last week/month/summer,
     ... ago, in 2010

  PRESENT PERFECT:
     ever, never, just, yet, already,
     for, since


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bellboy = mehmonxona xizmatchisi
  to tidy   = yig'ishtirmoq
  a chef    = oshpaz
  by bus    = avtobusda

items.textEn: 1  I'm a bellboy. I ..................... in a hotel.  A worked  B am working  C work
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'I'M A BELLBOY' — bu DOIMIY kasb.
Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'am working' — vaqtinchalik degan ma'no
berardi.
'worked' — o'tgan zamon, 'I'm a bellboy' ga zid.

items.textEn: 2  He ..................... his sister last weekend.  A visited  B is visiting  C visit
items.uz: U o'tgan dam olish kunlari opasinikiga bordi.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST WEEKEND' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

items.textEn: 3  I ..................... my room. Can I watch TV, now?  A tidy  B have tidied  C am tidying
items.uz: Xonamni yig'ishtirdim. Endi televizor ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'NOW' — ish TUGAGAN va natijasi
HOZIR muhim ('endi televizor ko'rsam
bo'ladimi?').

→ PRESENT PERFECT.

'am tidying' bo'lsa hali yig'ishtirayotgan
bo'lardi — televizor so'rash mantiqsiz.
tidy → TIDIED.

items.textEn: 4  She ..................... to music right now.  A listen  B is listening  C listened
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'RIGHT NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'listen TO music' — predlog 'to'.

items.textEn: 5  We ..................... to Canada last summer.  A went  B go  C am going
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST SUMMER' → PAST SIMPLE.
go → WENT.

items.textEn: 6  Julie ..................... a chef for six years.  A be  B been  C has been
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'FOR SIX YEARS' → PRESENT PERFECT.

A ('be') va B ('been') — yordamchi fe'lsiz
ishlatilmaydi:
  'Julie been a chef' ✗
  'Julie HAS BEEN a chef' ✓

Hozir HAM oshpaz (IKKINCHI qo'llanish).

items.textEn: 7  I usually ..................... TV every afternoon.  A watch  B am watching  C watched
items.uz: Men odatda har kuni tushdan keyin televizor ko'raman.
items.whyUz:
IKKI KALIT: 'USUALLY' va 'EVERY AFTERNOON'
— ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'I' — -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 8  She ..................... a book at the moment.  A reads  B read  C is reading
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

4-band bilan bir xil qoida
('right now' = 'at the moment').

items.textEn: 9  Joe ..................... some souvenirs in London last month.  A bought  B buy  C is buying
items.uz: Jo o'tgan oyda Londonda sovg'alar sotib oldi.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST MONTH' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT.

items.textEn: 10  My father always ..................... to work by bus.  A go  B goes  C is going
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALWAYS' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

⚠ EGA 'MY FATHER' — III SHAXS BIRLIK,
shuning uchun fe'lga -S: GOES.

A ('go') — grammatik jihatdan XATO.
C ('is going') — 'always' bilan mos kelmaydi.

'BY bus' — transport 'by' bilan, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  HAD              (NAMUNA)
 2  COMES
 3  WILL TAKE / 'LL TAKE
 4  DIDN'T PLAY
 5  DO YOU WANT
 6  IS SLEEPING
 7  WILL HELP / 'LL HELP
 8  DOES
 9  HAS JIM PAID
10  IS WASHING
11  HAVE JUST TURNED
12  HAVE YOU WORKED
13  HASN'T TRAVELLED
14  DON'T WE GO
15  DID YOU HEAR


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'We HAD chicken for dinner LAST NIGHT.'
    'last night' → PAST SIMPLE. (NAMUNA)

 2  'My father ALWAYS ... home at 6 pm.'
    'always' → ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'My father' → -S: COMES.

 3  'Finish your homework and I ... you to the
     park.'
    Shart-natija: agar tugatsang, olib boraman.
    Va'da → WILL.
    → WILL TAKE

 4  'Sara ... football with us YESTERDAY.'
    'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR.
    → DIDN'T PLAY
    (DIQQAT: 'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!)

 5  '... something to drink?'
    'want' — HIS fe'li, Continuous bo'lmaydi.
    Savol → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    → DO YOU WANT

 6  'Please be quiet! The baby ...'
    Ayni damda uxlayapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → IS SLEEPING

 7  'OK! I ... you with your maths.'
    'OK!' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilinyapti
    → WILL.
    → WILL HELP

 8  'Jill ... the shopping EVERY SATURDAY
     MORNING.'
    'every Saturday morning' → ODAT →
    PRESENT SIMPLE.
    Ega 'Jill' → -S: DOES.

 9  '... the phone bill YET?'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    → HAS JIM PAID
    (pay → PAID)

10  'Jason ... the car NOW.'
    'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → IS WASHING

11  'Don't touch the stove! I ... it on!'
    'just' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE JUST TURNED
    ('turn on' — ajraladigan fe'l)

12  'HOW LONG ... here?'
    'how long' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU WORKED

13  'Nicole ... to Spain.'
    Vaqt aytilmagan, tajriba → PRESENT PERFECT
    INKOR.
    → HASN'T TRAVELLED

14  'The weather is nice. WHY ... to the
     beach?'
    'Why don't we ...?' — TAKLIF qilish shakli.
    → DON'T WE GO

15  'WHEN ... the bad news?'
    'when' — ANIQ VAQT so'ralyapti →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → DID YOU HEAR


⚠ 14-BAND — MAXSUS QURILMA:
  'WHY DON'T WE go to the beach?'
  = plyajga borsak-chi?

  Bu — TAKLIF qilish shakli (Unit 14 dan):
     'Why don't you ...?' — sizga taklif
     'Why don't we ...?' — birgalikda taklif

  Qavsda '(not/we/go)' berilgani shuning
  uchun.


⚠ 15-BAND — 'WHEN' → PAST SIMPLE:
  'WHEN DID YOU HEAR the bad news?'

  'When HAVE you heard?' — XATO!
  'when' aniq vaqt so'raydi, shuning uchun
  Present Perfect ISHLATILMAYDI.

  Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi
  (Coursebook 105-bet, Speaking bo'limi).


DIQQAT — 'DIDN'T' va 'HASN'T' DAN KEYIN:
   4  'Sara DIDN'T PLAY' — ASOSIY shakl
  13  'Nicole HASN'T TRAVELLED' — V3

  'didn't' + V1;  'hasn't' + V3.


DIQQAT — 'TURN ON' (11-band):
  'I've just turned IT ON.'
  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     turn it on   ✓
     turn on it   ✗

  'a stove' = plita, pech.


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' (13-band):
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stove      = plita, pech
  to turn on   = yoqmoq
  maths        = matematika
  the bad news = yomon xabar
  to hear      = eshitmoq (hear → HEARD)

items.sentence: 2  My father always ........................... (come) home at 6 pm.
items.uz: Dadam doim soat 6 da uyga keladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALWAYS' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'My father' — III shaxs BIRLIK → -S:
COMES.

items.sentence: 3  Finish your homework and I ........................... (take) you to the park.
items.uz: Uy vazifangni tugat, men seni bog'ga olib boraman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Shart-natija: agar tugatsang, olib boraman.
Bu — VA'DA → WILL.

Unit 13 dan: WILL — va'da va ayni damdagi
qaror.

items.uz: Sara kecha biz bilan futbol o'ynamadi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR.

⚠ 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'didn't PLAY'   ✓
  'didn't PLAYED' ✗

'WANT' — HIS/XOHISH fe'li, Continuous
shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'Are you wanting?' — XATO!

Shu kabi: like, love, hate, know, need.

Ayni damda uxlayapti → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'Please be quiet!' — hozir sodir bo'layotgan
harakat borligini ko'rsatadi.

KALIT: 'OK!' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilinyapti → WILL.

Unit 13 dan: WILL — ayni damdagi qaror.

'help somebody WITH something' — predlog
'with'.

items.sentence: 8  Jill ........................... (do) the shopping every Saturday morning.
items.uz: Jill har shanba ertalab xarid qiladi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'EVERY SATURDAY MORNING' — ODAT
→ PRESENT SIMPLE.

Ega 'Jill' — III shaxs BIRLIK → DOES
('do' emas).

KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.

HAS + ega + V3:
'HAS Jim PAID ...?'

pay → PAID (V2 = V3).

KALIT: 'NOW' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

DIQQAT — 8-mashqning 3-bandi bilan
solishtiring:
  'I HAVE TIDIED my room. Can I watch TV NOW?'
     (ish tugagan)
  'Jason IS WASHING the car NOW.'
     (ish davom etyapti)

KALIT: 'JUST' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'just' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

'turn ON' — ajraladigan fe'l:
  'turned IT ON'  ✓
  'turned ON IT'  ✗

'a stove' = plita, pech.

items.uz: Bu yerda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.

Grammar 66-bet, 7-mashqning 6-bandi bilan
bir xil.

Vaqt AYTILMAGAN, TAJRIBA haqida
→ PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

'hasn't' + V3: TRAVELLED.

DIQQAT — YOZILISHI:
travel → TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L').

items.sentence: 14  The weather is nice. Why ................................ (not/we/go) to the beach?

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ MAXSUS QURILMA — TAKLIF QILISH:
'WHY DON'T WE go to the beach?'
= plyajga borsak-chi?

Unit 14 dan:
  'Why don't YOU ...?' — sizga taklif
  'Why don't WE ...?' — birgalikda taklif

Qavsda '(not/we/go)' berilgani shuning
uchun.

⚠ KALIT: 'WHEN' — ANIQ VAQT so'ralyapti
→ PAST SIMPLE.

'When HAVE you heard?' — XATO!
Present Perfect ANIQ VAQT bilan
ishlatilmaydi.

Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi
(Coursebook 105-bet, Speaking).

'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl: HEAR
('heard' EMAS).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  f      6  b
   2  d      7  j
   3  h      8  c
   4  a      9  e
   5  i     10  g


⚠ OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
YORDAMChI FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

  'HAVE you ...?'  →  'No, I HAVEN'T.'   (1-f)
  'WILL it ...?'   →  'Yes, it WILL.'    (2-d)
  'DO you ...?'    →  'No, I DON'T.'     (4-a)
  'IS she ...?'    →  'Yes, she IS.'     (8-c)
  'ARE you ...?'   →  'No, I'M NOT.'     (9-e)

  Beshta bandni FAQAT shu qoida bilan topish
  mumkin!


QOLGAN BESh BAND — SAVOL SO'ZI BO'YIChA:

  'WHAT is she DOING right now?'
     → harakat kerak → 'She's READING.' (3-h)

  'HOW OFTEN do you visit?'
     → chastota kerak → 'ONCE A WEEK.' (5-i)

  'HOW LONG have you lived?'
     → muddat kerak → 'FOR FOUR YEARS.' (6-b)

  'WHEN DID you become?'
     → o'tgan vaqt kerak → 'SEVEN YEARS AGO.'
       (7-j)

  'WHEN ARE you leaving?'
     → kelajak vaqt kerak → 'TOMORROW.' (10-g)


⚠ 7 va 10-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK JUFTLIK:

  Ikkalasi ham 'WHEN' bilan boshlanadi,
  lekin ZAMONI boshqa:

   7  'When DID you become a lawyer?'
         PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan)
      → 'Seven years AGO.' (o'tgan)

  10  'When ARE you LEAVING for Germany?'
         PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak reja)
      → 'TOMORROW.' (kelajak)

  Ya'ni javob ham o'tmishga, ham kelajakka
  tegishli bo'lishi mumkin — savolning
  ZAMONI hal qiladi.


⚠ 5 va 6-BANDLAR — YANA BIR JUFTLIK:

   5  'HOW OFTEN do you visit your parents?'
      → CHASTOTA (necha marta)
      → 'Once a week.' (haftada bir marta)

   6  'HOW LONG have you lived in London?'
      → MUDDAT (qancha vaqtdan beri)
      → 'For four years.'

  'How often' ≠ 'How long'!


⚠ 8 va 9-BANDLAR — 'IS' va 'ARE':

   8  'IS SHE staying ...?'  → 'Yes, SHE IS.'
   9  'ARE YOU going ...?'   → 'No, I'M NOT.'

  DIQQAT: 'Are you' savoliga javob 'I am not'
  (ega o'zgaradi: 'you' → 'I').


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT (savol → javob):

 1  Have you ever been to Paris?
    → f  No, I haven't.        (NAMUNA)
 2  Will it rain tomorrow?
    → d  Yes, it will.
 3  What is she doing right now?
    → h  She's reading.
 4  Do you watch TV every day?
    → a  No, I don't.
 5  How often do you visit your parents?
    → i  Once a week.
 6  How long have you lived in London?
    → b  For four years.
 7  When did you become a lawyer?
    → j  Seven years ago.
 8  Is she staying at Karen's house?
    → c  Yes, she is.
 9  Are you going to Hungary?
    → e  No, I'm not.
10  When are you leaving for Germany?
    → g  Tomorrow.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How often ...? = necha marta? qanchalik
                   tez-tez?
  once a week    = haftada bir marta
  a lawyer       = yurist, advokat
  to become      = bo'lmoq (become → BECAME)
  to leave for   = ... ga jo'namoq
  Germany        = Germaniya

pairs.left: 1  Have you ever been to Paris?
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.

QISQA JAVOB savoldagi yordamchi fe'lni
TAKRORLAYDI:
'HAVE you ...?' → 'No, I HAVEN'T.'

'WILL it ...?' → 'Yes, it WILL.'

Qisqa javob savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi.
'IT' — ob-havo egasi (Unit 13).

pairs.left: 3  What is she doing right now?
pairs.whyUz:
'WHAT is she DOING?' — HARAKAT so'ralyapti.

Javob ham PRESENT CONTINUOUS da:
'She'S READING' (= she IS reading).

'right now' → Present Continuous.

pairs.left: 4  Do you watch TV every day?
pairs.whyUz:
'DO you ...?' → 'No, I DON'T.'

'every day' → Present Simple.

pairs.left: 5  How often do you visit your parents?
pairs.whyUz:
'HOW OFTEN' — CHASTOTA so'ralyapti.

Javob: 'Once a week' (haftada bir marta).

⚠ 6-BAND BILAN ADASHTIRMANG:
  'How OFTEN' = necha marta
  'How LONG'  = qancha vaqtdan beri

pairs.left: 6  How long have you lived in London?
pairs.whyUz:
'HOW LONG' — MUDDAT so'ralyapti.

Javob: 'FOR four years' (davomiylik).

'How long' savoli DOIM Present Perfect bilan.

pairs.left: 7  When did you become a lawyer?
pairs.whyUz:
'WHEN DID you ...?' — PAST SIMPLE savoli.

Javob ham O'TGAN vaqt: 'Seven years AGO'.
'ago' — Past Simple ko'rsatkichi.

⚠ 10-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  7  'When DID you ...?' → o'tmish
  10 'When ARE you ...?' → kelajak

become → BECAME.

pairs.left: 8  Is she staying at Karen's house?
pairs.whyUz:
'IS she ...?' → 'Yes, she IS.'

Qisqa javob savoldagi 'be' fe'lini
takrorlaydi.

'Karen'S house' — egalik apostrofi.

'ARE YOU ...?' → 'No, I'M NOT.'

DIQQAT: ega o'zgaradi ('you' → 'I').

Salbiy qisqa javobda 'I'm not' ✓
('I amn't' degan shakl YO'Q).

pairs.left: 10  When are you leaving for Germany?
pairs.whyUz:
'When ARE you LEAVING?' — PRESENT CONTINUOUS
(kelajakdagi reja).

Javob ham KELAJAK: 'Tomorrow.'

'to leave FOR a place' = ... ga jo'namoq.

⚠ 7-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING: ikkalasi ham
'When' bilan, lekin zamoni boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. — Laura's letter from Dublin
exercises.instructionUz: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. — Lauraning Dublindan yozgan xati
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  IS
   2  AM HAVING
   3  AM STAYING
   4  HAVE BEEN
   5  HAVE ALREADY DONE
   6  HAVE SEEN
   7  WAS
   8  HAVE ALSO VISITED
   9  VISITED
  10  SHOWED
  11  HAVEN'T DONE
  12  HAVEN'T DONE
  13  HAVEN'T BEEN
  14  IS
  15  AM COMING
  16  WILL CALL / 'LL CALL


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Andrea,

  Hello from Dublin! The weather IS fantastic
  and I AM HAVING a wonderful time. I AM
  STAYING at a comfortable hotel near the city
  centre. I HAVE BEEN here since Thursday and
  I HAVE ALREADY DONE many interesting things.
  I HAVE SEEN a play at the Abbey Theatre. It
  WAS very entertaining! I HAVE ALSO VISITED
  the Guinness Brewery. I VISITED it on
  Saturday. They SHOWED our tour group how
  they make beer.

  There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T DONE
  yet. I HAVEN'T DONE any shopping on Grafton
  Street yet and I HAVEN'T BEEN to any pubs
  yet.

  Dublin IS a very friendly city — you must
  visit it one day. I AM COMING back on the
  16th, so I WILL CALL you then.

                            Love,
                            Laura


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Andrea,

  Dublindan salom! Havo ajoyib va men zo'r
  vaqt o'tkazyapman. Shahar markazi yonidagi
  qulay mehmonxonada turibman. Payshanbadan
  beri shu yerdaman va allaqachon ko'p
  qiziqarli ishlar qildim. Abbey teatrida
  spektakl ko'rdim. Juda maroqli edi!
  Guinness pivo zavodiga ham borganman.
  U yerga shanba kuni bordim. Ular bizning
  ekskursiya guruhimizga pivoni qanday
  tayyorlashni ko'rsatishdi.

  Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Grafton
  ko'chasida hali xarid qilmadim va hali
  hech qanday pabga bormadim.

  Dublin — juda do'stona shahar, bir kun
  kelib albatta borishing kerak. 16-sanada
  qaytaman, o'shanda senga qo'ng'iroq
  qilaman.

                    Mehr bilan, Laura


⚠ BU XAT — COURSEBOOK 105-BETDAGI JEKNING
XATINING AYNAN NUSXASI:

  Jek (Qohira):        Laura (Dublin):
  ────────────────     ─────────────────
  'The weather IS      'The weather IS
   very hot'            fantastic'
  'I'M HAVING a        'I AM HAVING a
   wonderful time'      wonderful time'
  'I'M STAYING with    'I AM STAYING at a
   my friend'           hotel'
  'I've BEEN here      'I HAVE BEEN here
   SINCE Monday'        SINCE Thursday'
  'I've ALREADY        'I HAVE ALREADY
   DONE lots of         DONE many
   things'              things'
  'I've ALREADY        'I HAVE SEEN a play'
   VISITED ...'
  'We VISITED it       'I VISITED it ON
   ON Tuesday'          Saturday'
  'I HAVEN'T BEEN      'I HAVEN'T BEEN to
   ... YET'             any pubs YET'
  'Cairo is a          'Dublin IS a very
   FASCINATING city'    FRIENDLY city'
  'I'M RETURNING ...   'I AM COMING back
   so I'LL CALL you     on the 16th, so I
   then'                WILL CALL you then'

  Kitob ataylab bir xil qolipni bergan!


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'The weather ... fantastic'
    Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

 2  'I ... a wonderful time'
    Hozir davom etayotgan → PRESENT
    CONTINUOUS. → AM HAVING

 3  'I ... at a comfortable hotel'
    VAQTINChALIK turish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM STAYING

 4  'I ... here SINCE THURSDAY'
    'since' → PRESENT PERFECT. → HAVE BEEN

 5  'I ... (already/do) many things'
    'already' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE ALREADY DONE

 6  'I ... a play at the Abbey Theatre'
    Vaqt aytilmagan → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE SEEN

 7  'It ... very entertaining!'
    O'sha spektakl haqida BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WAS

 8  'I ... (also/visit) the Guinness Brewery'
    Vaqt aytilmagan → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE ALSO VISITED

 9  'I ... it ON SATURDAY'
    'on Saturday' — ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
    → VISITED

10  'They ... our tour group how they make
     beer'
    O'sha tashrif haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
    → SHOWED

11  'a lot of things I ... YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T DONE

12  'I ... any shopping ... YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T DONE

13  'I ... to any pubs YET'
    'yet' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.
    → HAVEN'T BEEN
    (DIQQAT: 'gone' EMAS — Grammar 65-bet
     qoidasi)

14  'Dublin ... a very friendly city'
    Doimiy holat → PRESENT SIMPLE. → IS

15  'I ... back ON THE 16TH'
    Aniq sanali REJA → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM COMING

16  'so I ... you then'
    VA'DA → WILL. → WILL CALL


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — 6/7 va 8/9:

   6  'I HAVE SEEN a play.'     (vaqt yo'q)
   7  'It WAS very entertaining!' (baho)

   8  'I HAVE ALSO VISITED the Brewery.'
                                 (vaqt yo'q)
   9  'I VISITED it ON SATURDAY.' (aniq vaqt)

  Present Perfect (xabar) → Past Simple
  (tafsilot/baho). Bu — Unit 15 ning oltin
  qoidasi.


DIQQAT — 11 va 12-BANDLAR IKKALASI HAM
'HAVEN'T DONE':
  11  'things I HAVEN'T DONE yet'
  12  'I HAVEN'T DONE any shopping'

  Ikkalasida ham 'do' fe'li, lekin
  to'ldiruvchisi boshqa.

  'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKORDA:
  'I haven't done ANY shopping.'
  'I haven't been to ANY pubs.'

  INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY'.


DUBLINDAGI JOYLAR:
  the Abbey Theatre — Irlandiyaning milliy
     teatri (1904-yildan)
  the Guinness Brewery — mashhur pivo zavodi
     (1759-yildan)
  Grafton Street — Dublinning asosiy xarid
     ko'chasi
  a pub — an'anaviy irland/ingliz bari


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Dublin        = Dublin (Irlandiya poytaxti)
  comfortable   = qulay
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  entertaining  = maroqli, qiziqarli
  a brewery     = pivo zavodi
  a tour group  = ekskursiya guruhi
  beer          = pivo
  a pub         = pab, bar
  friendly      = do'stona
  on the 16th   = 16-sanada

commonMistake.whyUz:
Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Coursebook 105-bet, Jekning xati:
'The weather IS very hot here.'

Hozir davom etayotgan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'to have a wonderful time' — bu ma'noda
'have' Continuous BO'LADI
(egalik ma'nosida esa bo'lmaydi).

Jekning xati: 'I'M HAVING a wonderful time.'

items.sentence: 3  I ......................... (stay) at a comfortable hotel near the city centre.
items.uz: Shahar markazi yonidagi qulay mehmonxonada turibman.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQTINCHALIK turish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'I stay at a hotel' — doimiy odat degan
ma'no berardi.

Jekning xati: 'I'M STAYING with my friend.'

KALIT: 'SINCE Thursday' → PRESENT PERFECT.

be → BEEN.

Jekning xati: 'I've BEEN here SINCE Monday.'

items.uz: va allaqachon ko'p qiziqarli ishlar qildim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.

'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.
do → DONE.

Jekning xati: 'I've ALREADY DONE lots of
things!'

items.sentence: 6  I ......................... (see) a play at the Abbey Theatre.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.
see → SEEN.

⚠ 7-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  6  'I HAVE SEEN a play.'     (xabar)
  7  'It WAS entertaining!'    (baho)

O'sha spektakl haqida BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.

Baho DOIM Past Simple da beriladi:
Jekning xati: 'They WERE amazing.'
'The place WAS fantastic.'

'entertaining' = maroqli, qiziqarli.

Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.

'ALSO' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
'I have ALSO visited ...'

Jekning xati: 'I have ALSO SEEN the
Pyramids.'

KALIT: 'ON SATURDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ 8-BAND BILAN JUFT:
  8  'I HAVE ALSO VISITED ...'  (vaqt yo'q)
  9  'I VISITED it ON SATURDAY.' (aniq vaqt)

Jekning xati: 'We VISITED it ON TUESDAY.'

items.sentence: 10  They ......................... (show) our tour group how they make beer.
items.uz: Ular ekskursiya guruhimizga pivoni qanday tayyorlashni ko'rsatishdi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'sha tashrif haqida (shanba kuni)
→ PAST SIMPLE.

show → SHOWED (to'g'ri fe'l).

'a tour group' = ekskursiya guruhi.
'how they make beer' — ergash gap
(so'z tartibi TO'G'RI, savol tartibi emas).

items.sentence: 11  There are a lot of things I ......................... (not/do) yet.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

do → DONE.

Jekning xati: 'There are a lot of things I
HAVEN'T DONE YET.' — AYNAN bir xil gap!

items.sentence: 12  I ......................... (not/do) any shopping on Grafton Street yet

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

DIQQAT: INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY':
'haven't done ANY shopping'.

items.sentence: 13  and I ......................... (not/be) to any pubs yet.
items.uz: va hali hech qanday pabga bormadim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

⚠ 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS:
Grammar 65-bet qoidasi — 'have been to' =
tajriba (borib qaytish).

'ANY pubs' — inkor gapda 'any'.

Doimiy holat / fikr → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Jekning xati: 'Cairo IS a fascinating city.'

KALIT: 'ON THE 16TH' — ANIQ SANA bilan REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Unit 13 dan: aniq vaqtli reja → Present
Continuous.

Jekning xati: 'I'M RETURNING to England ON
SUNDAY next week.'

VA'DA → WILL.

Jekning xati: 'so I'LL CALL you then.' —
AYNAN bir xil gap!

Unit 13 dan: WILL — va'da.

groups.explanationUz: Bu jadval 8, 9 va 11-mashqlarning barcha bandlarini hal qiladi.

items.base: now, right now, at the moment

items.derivedUz: I HAVE JUST TURNED it on.
Julie HAS BEEN a chef for six years.
I AM COMING back on the 16th.

groups.ruleUz: SAVOL SO'ZLARI — QANDAY JAVOB TALAB QILADI

groups.explanationUz: Lauraning xati Jekning xatining aynan nusxasi.

items.base: I AM HAVING a wonderful time
so I WILL CALL you then

patterns.formula: I HAVE + [V3] ... .   →   I [V2] it ON + [kun].   →   It WAS + [sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: I have also visited the Guinness Brewery. I visited it on Saturday. It was very entertaining!
patterns.exampleUz: Guinness zavodiga ham borganman. U yerga shanba kuni bordim. Juda maroqli edi!
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ UNIT 15 NING OLTIN QOIDASI:
Present Perfect (xabar) → Past Simple
(aniq vaqt / baho).

patterns.exampleEn: The weather is nice. Why don't we go to the beach?
patterns.explanationUz:
BIRGALIKDA taklif qilish shakli.
'Why don't YOU ...?' — sizga taklif.

patterns.exampleEn: When did you become a lawyer? — Seven years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Qachon yurist bo'ldingiz? — Yetti yil oldin.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'WHEN' — ANIQ VAQT so'raydi → PAST SIMPLE.
'When have you ...?' — XATO!

patterns.exampleEn: When are you leaving for Germany? — Tomorrow.
patterns.explanationUz:
Present Continuous — KELAJAK rejasi.
'leave FOR a place' = ... ga jo'namoq.

patterns.formula: There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T + [V3] + YET.
patterns.exampleEn: There are a lot of things I haven't done yet. I haven't been to any pubs yet.
patterns.exampleUz: Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Hali hech qanday pabga bormadim.
patterns.explanationUz:
'YET' — inkorda, GAP OXIRIDA.
INKOR gapda 'ANY' ('some' EMAS).
